test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The simple interest on a certain sum for 3 years at 8% per annum is Rs. 96 more than the simple interest on the same sum for 2 years at 9% per annum. Find the sum.
solution:
**Given:**

The simple interest on a certain sum for 3 years at 8% per annum 

The simple interest on the same sum for 2 years at 9% per annum.

The difference between both schemes = Rs. 96

**Concept used:**

Simple interest = ((P × R × T))/(100)</
